T018 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  ((MeasurableSet unitI ∧ volume unitI = 1) ∧
      ∀ (B : Set ℝ) (ρ η : ℝ),
        B.Nonempty →
          0 ≤ ρ →
            Metric.ediam B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ →
              0 < η →
                Bornology.IsBounded B ∧
                  BddBelow B ∧
                    BddAbove B ∧
                      (∀ b ∈ B, sInf B ≤ b ∧ b ≤ sSup B) ∧
                        sSup B - sInf B ≤ ρ ∧
                          B ⊆ Ioo (sInf B - η / 2) (sSup B + η / 2) ∧
                            MeasurableSet (Ioo (sInf B - η / 2) (sSup B + η / 2)) ∧
                              0 < sSup B - sInf B + η ∧
                                sSup B - sInf B + η ≤ ρ + η ∧
                                  volume (Ioo (sInf B - η / 2) (sSup B + η / 2)) =
                                      ENNReal.ofReal (sSup B - sInf B + η) ∧
                                    volume (Ioo (sInf B - η / 2) (sSup B + η / 2) ∩ unitI) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ + η) ∧
                                      MeasurableSet (Ioo (sInf B - η / 2) (sSup B + η / 2) ∩ unitI)) →
    ∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (w : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (J : ℕ → Set ℝ),
      (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasurableSet (J i)) →
        (∀ t ∈ unitI, c ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), (J i).indicator (fun t0 => w i) t) →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable ((J i ∩ unitI).indicator fun t0 => w i)) ∧
            (∀ (t : ℝ), unitI.indicator (fun t0 => c) t ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), (J i ∩ unitI).indicator (fun t0 => w i) t) ∧
              c ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), w i * volume (J i ∩ unitI)
